notes: REJECTED from this pack (census evidence, 2026-07-20): tree-sitter-yaml.wasm (C++ external scanner detonates at parse on the @vscode runtime — ABI mismatch) and tree-sitter-lua.wasm (scanner misparses valid code, e.g. `local x = 1`); both are carried from the grammar's own release instead (their entries below). Update procedure: bump version+url, run scripts/vendor/fetch-grammars.ts --force, re-pin sha512 + per-file sha256 from its output, re-verify each upstream licence, re-run scripts/language-sidecars/prove-grammar-census.ts. A grammar entry may carry sourceUrl + sourceProvenance: its wasm then comes from THAT pinned https artifact instead of the pack tarball (same per-file sha256 law; swift rides the upstream 0.7.3 release asset because the pack's 0.4-era build fatally OOMs V8's optimizing wasm compiler — audition-fenced, see the registry's fragile marking). An entry that also names sourceMember + sourceSha512 takes its wasm as that member of the pinned tarball at sourceUrl (sha512 verified before the member is read): a grammar's own npm package, or a third party's build of a grammar that publishes no wasm, in which case upstream.builder names the builder's package and version and upstream.commit the revision the builder says it built. upstream.commit and upstream.copyright are recorded for every entry admitted with them; the licence was read from the upstream repository at that commit. The ordinary build consumes ONLY the verified local cache (vendor/grammars/extracted) or produces an honest degraded manifest. optimiserCostMb is the resident memory V8's optimising tier adds to the process under sustained parsing with that grammar (vendored node, the method of scripts/language-sidecars/prove-grammar-memory-hold.ts, which reads the whole table again with --measure): a grammar at 400 or more is marked baseline in the registry and parsed with the tier held off; the threshold sits in the gap of the measured costs.
